label: sevdesk documents
description: One record per invoice and per credit note the app creates in sevdesk, or tried to create. The app uses it to never create a document twice, and to continue one where an attempt stopped.

key.label: Key
key.description: The order or the refund the document belongs to. Unique, so each gets one document.

source.label: Started by
source.description: The store event or dashboard action that asked for the document.

name.label: Name
name.description: The document number once sevdesk has assigned one, the order until then.

number.label: Number
number.description: The document number sevdesk assigned when the document was finalized.

invoice_number.label: For invoice
invoice_number.description: On a credit note: the invoice it refunds.

reference.label: Refund reference
reference.description: Printed on a credit note to tell the refunds of one order apart.

sevdesk_status.label: Status in sevdesk
sevdesk_status.description: As it was when the app last read it.

contact_key.label: Contact key
contact_key.description: Orders with the same key share one sevdesk contact.

payment_method.label: Refunded by
payment_method.description: On a credit note: the payment method of the refund, which decides the sevdesk account the payout is booked on.

rates.label: Amounts per tax rate
rates.description: On a credit note: what it holds at each tax rate, including tax. sevdesk limits the credit notes of an invoice per tax rate.

date_booked.label: Payments handled
date_booked.description: Set once the app has dealt with the payments, whether or not anything was booked.

date_submitted.label: Submitted
date_submitted.description: Set while a create request to sevdesk has no answer yet.

date_pending.label: Waiting since
date_pending.description: Set while the document waits for sevdesk. After a day of waiting it is listed under Needs attention.

notify_customer.label: E-mailed to customer
notify_customer.description: Set by the app when the PDF is ready and e-mails are switched on. Setting it sends the e-mail.

types.description: The PDF is stored and the customer is to be e-mailed
